verdict.rationale: Fellow's Developer API is documented as standard REST access to transcripts and structured notes. A Recordings resource provides diarized, timestamped transcripts and meeting recaps, and a paginated action-items endpoint supports scope filters. Users can generate their own API keys, and the docs are machine-readable via llms.txt. Missing for 10: summary retrieval through the API is only implied via 'recap'/'structured notes' rather than shown as an explicit field; pulling every meeting workspace-wide requires an Enterprise Super Admin key; no published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404); no independent or hands-on corroboration.
